name: Hebei Haiwei Electronic New Material Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hebei Haiwei Electronic New Material Technology, incorporated in 2006 and based in Hengshui, researches, makes and sells capacitor films in China to film capacitor manufacturers. Products include capacitor base films of various thicknesses, metallized films, recycled granules, anti-theft label films and composite copper foil base films. An earlier version of the company was called Hebei Haiwei Electronic Material.
